entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""So, Mr. President... You are not w..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, Mr. President... You are not willing to resign, but willing to talk to the protesters..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She was a rising figure in Sordish..."
entries.dialogueText: She was a rising figure in Sordish politics, especially due to her involvement in organizing the largest women's marches.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Let me remind you, this is not a r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me remind you, this is not a regular protest. This is a movement."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""People are finally calling out for..."
entries.dialogueText: "People are finally calling out for the change they've been denied for so long. Your administration and your party left them no choice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Just make your point. You are fall..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just make your point. You are falling into diatribe."
entries.menuText: "Just make your point. You are falling into diatribe."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""People? How about you? What do you..."
entries.dialogueText: "People? How about you? What do you earn from inciting unrest?"
entries.menuText: "People? How about you? What do you earn from inciting unrest?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It seemed like she was navigating t..."
entries.dialogueText: It seemed like she was navigating the protests very cleverly and knew how to make people come together. She had somehow become the spokesperson for these massive "Soll Square Protests" against me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've done everything for my people.""
entries.dialogueText: "I've done everything for my people."
entries.menuText: "I've done everything for my people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I respect that, Mrs. Horten. That'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect that, Mrs. Horten. That's why we're here to have a discussion."
entries.menuText: "I respect that, Mrs. Horten. That's why we're here to have a discussion."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Did you even look at these people,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you even look at these people, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What you are doing is illegal. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "What you are doing is illegal. We are in an emergency."
entries.menuText: "What you are doing is illegal. We are in an emergency."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""This is precisely why we had to sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is precisely why we had to speak out, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You cannot take away the right to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot take away the right to protest. This is an infringement on our basic rights as citizens of this country."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You are getting this all wrong, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are getting this all wrong, Mr. President. I do not *earn* anything from this..."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Nor am I inciting any unrest.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor am I inciting any unrest."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You think they cannot distinguish..."
entries.dialogueText: "You think they cannot distinguish right from wrong? That they always need a leader figure to organize?"

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You are tremendously wrong. You mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are tremendously wrong. You must accept that people do not support you anymore, Mr. President. You've done wrong by them. By all of us."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""And I appreciate that.""
entries.dialogueText: "And I appreciate that."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Maybe your values are different fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe your values are different from what they want."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pointed out the window."
entries.dialogueText: She pointed out the window.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You brought people from all walks..."
entries.dialogueText: "You brought people from all walks of life together. People you'd never think would come together."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""But they did. This is a huge achie..."
entries.dialogueText: "But they did. This is a huge achievement. I can at least give you credit for that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've seen them, Mrs. Horten. And I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've seen them, Mrs. Horten. And I want to help."
entries.menuText: "I've seen them, Mrs. Horten. And I want to help."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nonsense. They are coming together..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonsense. They are coming together because of people like you."
entries.menuText: "Nonsense. They are coming together because of people like you."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You already know about the issues..."
entries.dialogueText: "You already know about the issues that made people take to the streets."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""We don't believe you can fix them..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't believe you can fix them anymore. That's why they're asking for your resignation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me with a single arch..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me with a single arched eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""But I don't think that's going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I don't think that's going to happen. Nor it is helpful at this moment. Elections are getting close anyway."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She frowned."
entries.dialogueText: She frowned.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You can't blame the actions of a c..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't blame the actions of a couple of policeman on the whole state. Nor on me."
entries.menuText: "You can't blame the actions of a couple of policeman on the whole state. Nor on me."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Instead, I want you to make amends.""
entries.dialogueText: "Instead, I want you to make amends."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""When peaceful protesters went out..."
entries.dialogueText: "When peaceful protesters went out to Soll Square to voice their opinion a few weeks ago, your police nearly beat them to death."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""This isn't about your policies any..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't about your policies anymore. This is about democracy and the fundamental right to be free. To be safe."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""The police state Soll created stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police state Soll created still lives on. Every president who takes the seat feels obliged to use that force. It needs to stop."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""The problem isn't their funding. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "The problem isn't their funding. It goes deeper than that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""These policemen acted on their own..."
entries.dialogueText: "These policemen acted on their own accord. We never gave them such orders."
entries.menuText: "These policemen acted on their own accord. We never gave them such orders."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've already defunded the police...."
entries.dialogueText: "I've already defunded the police. What more can I do?"
entries.menuText: "I've already defunded the police. What more can I do?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm ready to do something about th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm ready to do something about this."
entries.menuText: "I'm ready to do something about this."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""This has become a systemic problem.""
entries.dialogueText: "This has become a systemic problem."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You might not have given such orde..."
entries.dialogueText: "You might not have given such orders, but the police feels that they have the right to partake in such actions. And they do not suffer any consequences for it."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""I'm glad to hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad to hear it."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""The problem is a systemic one. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "The problem is a systemic one. The police feels that they have the right to partake in such actions. And they do not suffer any consequences for it."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""We want those responsible to be tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "We want those responsible to be tried. We want justice to be served."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Firstly, we want the dismissal of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Firstly, we want the dismissal of Karl Greiser, the Chief of Police, for his use of excessive force..."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""When peaceful protesters went out..."
entries.dialogueText: "When peaceful protesters went out to Soll Square to voice their opinion a few weeks ago, your police beat people to their deaths!"

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""This isn't about any of your other..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't about any of your other policies anymore. You finally formed your police state. This is about democracy and the fundamental right to be free. To be safe."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""The police state Soll created live..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police state Soll created lives on more powerful than ever. Every president who takes the seat feels obliged to use that force. It needs to stop."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm ready to do something about th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm ready to do something about this."
entries.menuText: "I'm ready to do something about this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""These policemen acted on their own..."
entries.dialogueText: "These policemen acted on their own accord. We never gave them such orders."
entries.menuText: "These policemen acted on their own accord. We never gave them such orders."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You can't blame the actions of a c..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't blame the actions of a couple of policeman on the whole state. Nor on me."
entries.menuText: "You can't blame the actions of a couple of policeman on the whole state. Nor on me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland had serious security prob..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland had serious security problems. These laws were necessary."
entries.menuText: "Sordland had serious security problems. These laws were necessary."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""I'm glad to hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad to hear it."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You gave them more authority than..."
entries.dialogueText: "You gave them more authority than ever. How are you denying your part in this?"

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""So, you are fine with killing your..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, you are fine with killing your own citizens?"

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Your security laws must be undone.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your security laws must be undone."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""We must start by undoing your secu..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must start by undoing your security laws."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She clenched her fists."
entries.dialogueText: She clenched her fists.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""...And we demand that your harsher..."
entries.dialogueText: "...And we demand that your harsher security laws be undone."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""...And we demand that Tarquin Soll..."
entries.dialogueText: "...And we demand that Tarquin Soll's security package laws be undone."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""We worked together with the indepe..."
entries.dialogueText: "We worked together with the independent MPs on a new Freedom Act."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""It must be implemented.""
entries.dialogueText: "It must be implemented."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can help you with these. What is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can help you with these. What is in this Freedom Act?"
entries.menuText: "I can help you with these. What is in this Freedom Act?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't dismiss Mr. Greiser just l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't dismiss Mr. Greiser just like that. He was doing his job."
entries.menuText: "I can't dismiss Mr. Greiser just like that. He was doing his job."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Out of the question.""
entries.dialogueText: "Out of the question."
entries.menuText: "Out of the question."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A muscle in her jaw twitched."
entries.dialogueText: A muscle in her jaw twitched.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You will continue the traditions o..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will continue the traditions of not giving a damn about the people!?"

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You seem not to understand the sit..."
entries.dialogueText: "You seem not to understand the situation, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""We know what your powers are. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "We know what your powers are. And these are the people's demands."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This country still has a functioni..."
entries.dialogueText: "This country still has a functioning government. I can't listen to the demands of every mob."
entries.menuText: "This country still has a functioning government. I can't listen to the demands of every mob."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sorry, Mrs. Horten. But I can'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Mrs. Horten. But I can't do it. You need to compromise."
entries.menuText: "I'm sorry, Mrs. Horten. But I can't do it. You need to compromise."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Mob?""
entries.dialogueText: "Mob?"

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""I thought you invited me here to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you invited me here to make compromises."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""The people have made many compromi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people have made many compromises, Mr. President. They stayed silent for decades. Now, it is your turn."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You might be right... What's in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You might be right... What's in this Freedom Act?"
entries.menuText: "You might be right... What's in this Freedom Act?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think they are being manipulated..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think they are being manipulated by people like you, Mrs. Horten. I doubt that these are their genuine demands."
entries.menuText: "I think they are being manipulated by people like you, Mrs. Horten. I doubt that these are their genuine demands."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm the president, Mrs. Horten. An..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm the president, Mrs. Horten. And I made my decision."
entries.menuText: "I'm the president, Mrs. Horten. And I made my decision."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Be careful with your tone, Mrs. Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful with your tone, Mrs. Horten. You are speaking to the president."
entries.menuText: "Be careful with your tone, Mrs. Horten. You are speaking to the president."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The meeting is over.""
entries.dialogueText: "The meeting is over."
entries.menuText: "The meeting is over."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She straightened her back."
entries.dialogueText: She straightened her back.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Firstly, no person will be detaine..."
entries.dialogueText: "Firstly, no person will be detained without proper trial."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You must end the state of emergenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must end the state of emergency now."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""We demand that you return from thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We demand that you return from this mistake and respect our democracy."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""We also demand the dismissal of Ka..."
entries.dialogueText: "We also demand the dismissal of Karl Greiser, the Chief of Police, for his use of excessive force..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The state of emergency remains.""
entries.dialogueText: "The state of emergency remains."
entries.menuText: "The state of emergency remains."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Investigating private property wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Investigating private property will require warrants issued by judges."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""The loopholes that give the police..."
entries.dialogueText: "The loopholes that give the police the right to use excessive force will be removed."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""And the police's right to stop and..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the police's right to stop and frisk anyone will be taken away."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Okay, I agree to all of your deman..."
entries.dialogueText: "Okay, I agree to all of your demands. I'll sign it."
entries.menuText: "Okay, I agree to all of your demands. I'll sign it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Okay, I agree to all of your deman..."
entries.dialogueText: "Okay, I agree to all of your demands. I'll support your bill too. And I promise to sign it if it passes the Assembly."
entries.menuText: "Okay, I agree to all of your demands. I'll support your bill too. And I promise to sign it if it passes the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. That is too much to ask.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. That is too much to ask."
entries.menuText: "No. That is too much to ask."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""How dare you even suggest that?""
entries.dialogueText: "How dare you even suggest that?"

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You cannot think clearly, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot think clearly, Mr. President. You are losing it all."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""It seems power have consumed you.""
entries.dialogueText: "It seems power have consumed you."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Yet you are losing it all.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yet you are losing it all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Please leave my office.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please leave my office."
entries.menuText: "Please leave my office."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not losing anything. But you'l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not losing anything. But you'll lose something if you continue speaking to me like that."
entries.menuText: "I'm not losing anything. But you'll lose something if you continue speaking to me like that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I care about the people, Mrs. Hort..."
entries.dialogueText: "I care about the people, Mrs. Horten. But politics is more complicated than that."
entries.menuText: "I care about the people, Mrs. Horten. But politics is more complicated than that."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""What's complicated about the tyran..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's complicated about the tyranny of the state?"

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You are a fake. And you claim to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are a fake. And you claim to be a socialist. You tried portraying yourself as a supporter of the working class."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stood up."
entries.dialogueText: She stood up.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""So, Mr. President... It's been a w..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, Mr. President... It's been a while."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Since our last confrontation, Katar..."
entries.dialogueText: Since our last confrontation, Katarina had become a rising figure in Sordish politics, organizing large women's marches as well as the massive "Soll Square Protests" against me.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""When you spoke in front of the Gas..."
entries.dialogueText: "When you spoke in front of the Gasom headquarters, you made it seem as if we were on the same side."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Did you learn nothing from our pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you learn nothing from our protests in Narbel? You cannot silence the people of Sordland, President Rayne. No matter how hard you try."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Did you mean any of what you said..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you mean any of what you said back then?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I did. And I still do. We are on t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did. And I still do. We are on the same side, Ms. Horten."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Times and positions change, Ms. Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Times and positions change, Ms. Horten. If you want to enter politics, that's the first thing you should know."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your people had me in a corner, Ms..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your people had me in a corner, Ms. Horten. I had to lie if I wanted to get out of there alive."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Did *you* learn anything, Ms. Hort..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did *you* learn anything, Ms. Horten? Speak against the President of Sordland, and you'll meet the wrong end of a nightstick."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My aim has never been to silence t..."
entries.dialogueText: "My aim has never been to silence the people of Sordland. I'm here talking to you, aren't I?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What I learned in Narbel is that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I learned in Narbel is that the President of Sordland will face criticism even if he is trying to do everything right."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You're not trying very hard, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not trying very hard, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""That's the very least you can do,..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the very least you can do, Mr. President. Especially after having my colleague Mr. Stahler arrested."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She flinched in shock, then quickly..."
entries.dialogueText: She flinched in shock, then quickly recomposed herself.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Well, today I want the truth.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, today I want the truth."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""That's a cop-out, Mr. President. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a cop-out, Mr. President. You have knowingly compromised the ideals you expressed to me back then."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""Not anymore, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not anymore, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""That's the very least you can do,..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the very least you can do, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You weren't trying very hard when..."
entries.dialogueText: "You weren't trying very hard when you had my colleague Mr. Stahler arrested."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""You dare to say that after what yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You dare to say that after what you did to Mr. Stahler?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It seemed like she was navigating t..."
entries.dialogueText: It seemed like she was navigating the protests very cleverly and knew how to make people come together. She had somehow become the spokesperson for these massive "Maroon Square Protests" against me.

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""When peaceful protesters went out..."
entries.dialogueText: "When peaceful protesters went out to Maroon Square to voice their opinion a few weeks ago, your police nearly beat them to death."

entries.speaker: Katarina Horten
entries.title: Katarina Horten: ""When peaceful protesters went out..."
entries.dialogueText: "When peaceful protesters went out to Maroon Square to voice their opinion a few weeks ago, your police beat people to their deaths!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Since our last confrontation, Katar..."
entries.dialogueText: Since our last confrontation, Katarina had become a rising figure in Sordish politics, organizing large women's marches as well as the massive "Maroon Square Protests" against me.
